about: M1-11's proposal for M1-10-a's plain-words.v2.json (box-spec-v2-draft.md § 9 item 3), used as a test fixture in wave 1. The checker reads these keys from the real file once it exists: enums.Leg, enums.Dest, enums.Split (label), recipe (sides, branches, parts), fields (label; fix or tell where a reason has no fix), reasons (sentence and fix; format 1's plain strings are read too) and notes. Fills in braces: {where} (the side, and the part of it where the check stopped, such as Buyers' fees, first part), {part}, {token}, {network}, {listing}, {P} (the pricing token's symbol), {T} (the box's token symbol), {cap}, {days}, {raise}, {powers}, {to}.
Wording (F99, F100, the founder's words in § 9 item 3): numbers first, one short sentence; never "Q" or "T" as words; a failed box pays the closing price, never a refund.
launchFlowCanEnter.zeroFields and addOns.placeholders.launchFlow are format 1's, unchanged: the launch flow fills the same values in format 2.

Review round 1: reasons 0-20 (format 1's, which keep their numbers, box-spec-v2-draft.md § 7) and a label for each of the 32 fields, so a refusal at an ordinary field reads as a sentence ("Token name is too short or too long."), never as a field or reason name.

Cap30Days.label: at most {cap} every 30 days, the rest

UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.sentence: {where}: this version does not exist; every new box is version 2.

NOT_A_MEMBER.sentence: {where}: the value is not one of its choices.
NOT_A_MEMBER.fix: Pick one of the choices in references/v2/fields.md, or one --menu offers.

NOT_OFFERED.sentence: {where}: {part} is not built in this release yet.
NOT_OFFERED.fix: Pick one the menu offers (--menu); the rest comes with M2 and M3.

OUT_OF_RANGE.sentence: {where}: the number is outside its range.
OUT_OF_RANGE.fix: Use a value within the range references/v2/fields.md gives.

LENGTH_OUT_OF_RANGE.sentence: {where} is too short or too long.
LENGTH_OUT_OF_RANGE.fix: Check the text on its own with --field, which says how long it may be.

BAD_CHARACTER.sentence: {where} has a character that is not allowed.
BAD_CHARACTER.fix: Use plain ASCII: no emoji, accents, curly quotes or long dashes; --field shows which character.

ZERO_VALUE.fix: Fill it in, or write "FROM_LAUNCH_FLOW" where the launch flow enters it.

MUST_BE_ZERO.sentence: {where} must be empty for this kind of box.
MUST_BE_ZERO.fix: Write 0, "0x" or the zero address, as references/v2/fields.md says.

Q_NOT_LISTED.sentence: {where}: the pricing token is not a listing of this release.
Q_NOT_LISTED.fix: Name the token by its symbol from --menu.

RAISE_NOT_A_PRESET.sentence: {where}: the raise is not the one its listing sets.
RAISE_NOT_A_PRESET.fix: Write "raise": "LISTING" and let the checker fill it in.

MENU_RULE.sentence: {where}: these choices do not go together.
MENU_RULE.fix: Start again from the closest worked example or configuration.

TOO_MANY_ADD_ONS.sentence: {where}: too many add-ons for one box.

ADD_ON_ORDER.sentence: {where}: the add-ons are out of order or repeated.
ADD_ON_ORDER.fix: List each add-on once, in the order --menu lists them.

ADD_ON_UNKNOWN.sentence: {where}: an add-on the catalog does not list.
ADD_ON_UNKNOWN.fix: Write add-ons by key, as --menu lists them.

ADD_ON_NOT_AVAILABLE.sentence: {where}: this add-on is not offered in this release.
ADD_ON_NOT_AVAILABLE.fix: Remove it; --menu lists the add-ons offered.

ADD_ON_PARAMS_MALFORMED.sentence: {where}: the add-on's settings are not encoded as the catalog expects.
ADD_ON_PARAMS_MALFORMED.fix: Write it by key with its settings and let the checker encode them.

ADD_ON_REQUIRED.sentence: {where}: this choice needs an add-on that is missing.
ADD_ON_REQUIRED.fix: Add the add-on it needs, or change the choice.

ADD_ON_CONFLICT.sentence: {where}: an add-on does not fit the rest of the box.
ADD_ON_CONFLICT.fix: Change the box, or remove the add-on.

METADATA_TABLE_MALFORMED.sentence: {where}: the trait table is not in the stored format.
METADATA_TABLE_MALFORMED.fix: Write "FROM_LAUNCH_FLOW" and let the launch flow write the table.

LISTING_UNKNOWN.sentence: Listing {listing} is not a listing of this release on {network}.
LISTING_UNKNOWN.fix: Name the token by its symbol from --menu; one listed after the offline copy shows with --listings or --indexer.

LISTING_MISMATCH.fix: Name the token by its symbol and let the checker fill in its newest listing.

RECIPE_RULE.fix: Pick another pair from --menu for this side.

SPLIT_RULE.sentence: {where}: {part} does not fit. Two caps in one box name the same amount and the same first part.
SPLIT_RULE.fix: Use the same cap and the same first part on both sides, or one cap.

PLUG_IN_MALFORMED.sentence: {where}: {part} is not a plug-in the checker can read.
PLUG_IN_MALFORMED.fix: Name a reviewed plug-in by its id from --menu.

GAS_BUDGET.sentence: {where}: more plug-ins or plug-in settings than one box carries.
GAS_BUDGET.fix: Drop a plug-in or shorten its settings: at most 4 plug-ins and add-ons with contracts per box.

notes.notLive: Not live yet: a format 2 box runs on the release the network names.
notes.tableLoads: The table loads in a few transactions after Create; the box opens once they are all in.
notes.raiseChecked: Raise {raise} {P}: the lowest reading of {P} now. The factory reads it again at Create.
notes.nonEthOpen: Buyers pay in {P}: in the first 6.4 minutes they need {P} and one approval, or the ETH-in helper.
notes.closing: Not reached in {days} days: the box closes and every holder can sell back at the closing price, in {P}.
notes.humble: You take at most {cap} every 30 days; the rest goes into your pool. Your own token waits there until it can be paired. A public promise, not a lock.
notes.notChecked: Read and encoded, not accepted yet: format 2's check (M1-10's twin) is not in this checkout.
